name: nogbase
description: Real-estate sales workflows on Nogbase: the Nogbase connector with four skills for branded sales offers with every payment-plan installment, client shortlists from a buyer brief, project briefs in English or Arabic, and deal checks that present Nogbase's investment estimate for a unit. Read-only: it reads only the projects and units your Nogbase workspace may see and never changes your data.

interface.longDescription:
Nogbase helps real-estate brokers and property developers work with their Nogbase inventory, including off-plan projects. Search projects and units by area, developer, bedrooms, budget and currency, handover date, amenities, and payment-plan terms; compare projects for a client; read project details, brochures, and images; and prepare a sales offer or project brief with every payment-plan installment and your company letterhead. Developers can also review their own projects and recent inventory changes.

Version 1.4 includes four skills that guide these workflows step by step: Sales offer (a branded offer for one unit at the quoted price, with every installment computed by Nogbase), Client shortlist (a buyer brief turned into filtered searches and a side-by-side comparison), Project brief (a project summary in English, Arabic, or both), and Deal check (Nogbase's investment estimate for one unit from DLD sales, with sources, as-of dates and a disclaimer; an estimate, not advice).

The connector's tools only read inventory your workspace may see; they never change your data. A Nogbase broker or developer account is required.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a one-page sales offer for this unit at AED 1,850,000 with my company letterhead.
Compare three projects for a client who wants a one-bedroom with at most 10% on booking.
Write a project brief for this project in Arabic.
